CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.audit_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid=auth.uid(); data jsonb;
begin
 if actor is not null then
 data=case when tg_op='DELETE' then to_jsonb(old) else to_jsonb(new) end;
 insert into public.audit_logs(admin_id,entity_name,entity_id,action,old_data,new_data)
 values(actor,tg_table_name,coalesce((data->>'id')::uuid,(data->>'product_id')::uuid,(data->>'variant_id')::uuid,(data->>'category_id')::uuid),lower(tg_op),case when tg_op<>'INSERT' then to_jsonb(old)-'storage_path' end,case when tg_op<>'DELETE' then to_jsonb(new)-'storage_path' end);
 end if;return coalesce(new,old);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.category_composition_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if new.requires_composition is distinct from old.requires_composition and exists(select 1 from public.products where primary_category_id=new.id and status='published' and deleted_at is null) then raise exception 'Unpublish affected products before changing composition rules';end if;return new;end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.category_rules(category uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(attribute_id uuid, applies_to text, is_required boolean, sort_order integer, source_category_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with recursive ancestors as (
    select c.id,c.parent_id,0 as depth,array[c.id] as path from public.categories c where c.id=category
    union all
    select c.id,c.parent_id,a.depth+1,a.path||c.id
    from public.categories c join ancestors a on c.id=a.parent_id
    where a.depth<7 and not c.id=any(a.path)
  )
  select distinct on (ca.attribute_id,ca.applies_to)
    ca.attribute_id,ca.applies_to::text,ca.is_required,ca.sort_order,ca.category_id
  from ancestors a join public.category_attributes ca on ca.category_id=a.id
  order by ca.attribute_id,ca.applies_to,a.depth
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.check_frozen_tiers(product uuid, rows jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare price record; existing jsonb; submitted jsonb;
begin
  for price in select pr.id from public.variant_prices pr join public.product_variants v on v.id=pr.variant_id
    join public.products p on p.id=v.product_id
    where p.id=product and p.published_at is not null and pr.created_at<=p.published_at loop
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)-'created_at'-'updated_at' order by t.id),'[]'::jsonb)
      into existing from public.price_tiers t where t.variant_price_id=price.id;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)-'created_at'-'updated_at' order by t.id),'[]'::jsonb)
      into submitted from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::public.price_tiers,rows) t where t.variant_price_id=price.id;
    if existing is distinct from submitted then raise exception 'Published price tiers are immutable; append a replacement price and tiers'; end if;
  end loop;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.mapped_attribute_publication_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if ((old.is_active and not new.is_active) or
      (new.data_type,new.default_unit_id,new.is_variant_axis) is distinct from
      (old.data_type,old.default_unit_id,old.is_variant_axis)) and exists (
    with recursive affected_categories as (
      select ca.category_id as id from public.category_attributes ca where ca.attribute_id=old.id
      union select c.id from public.categories c join affected_categories a on c.parent_id=a.id
    ) select 1 from public.products p join affected_categories a on a.id=p.primary_category_id
      where p.status='published' and p.deleted_at is null
  ) then raise exception 'Unpublish affected products before changing mapped specification semantics'; end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.price_context_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- Serialize canonical-context checks with competing writers for this SKU.
  perform 1 from public.product_variants where id=new.variant_id for update;
  if tg_op='INSERT' then new.trade_term=upper(btrim(new.trade_term)); end if;
  if new.is_active and exists(select 1 from public.variant_prices stored where stored.variant_id=new.variant_id
    and stored.id<>new.id and stored.is_active and stored.currency_code=new.currency_code
    and stored.price_unit_id=new.price_unit_id and upper(btrim(stored.trade_term))=upper(btrim(new.trade_term))
    and tstzrange(stored.valid_from,stored.valid_until,'[)') && tstzrange(new.valid_from,new.valid_until,'[)'))
  then raise exception 'Active price periods overlap in the same currency, unit and trade context' using errcode='23P01'; end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.specification_matches(attribute uuid, choice uuid, txt text, num numeric, flag boolean, unit uuid, filter jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(exists(select 1 from public.attribute_definitions a
    left join public.units du on du.id=a.default_unit_id
    left join public.units u on u.id=unit
    where a.id=attribute and a.id=(filter->>'attribute')::uuid and a.is_active and a.is_filterable
      and (case a.data_type
        when 'select' then choice=(filter->>'option')::uuid
        when 'multi_select' then choice=(filter->>'option')::uuid
        when 'boolean' then flag=(filter->>'boolean')::boolean
        when 'text' then lower(txt)=lower(filter->>'text')
        when 'number' then
          (a.default_unit_id is null and unit is null or
            u.id=du.id or u.unit_family=du.unit_family and u.factor_to_base is not null and du.factor_to_base is not null)
          and (not filter ? 'min' or num*coalesce(u.factor_to_base/du.factor_to_base,1)>=(filter->>'min')::numeric)
          and (not filter ? 'max' or num*coalesce(u.factor_to_base/du.factor_to_base,1)<=(filter->>'max')::numeric)
        else false end)),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public_catalog.category_filters(category_filter text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '8s'
AS $function$
  with rules as (
    select distinct r.attribute_id from public.categories c
    cross join lateral private.category_rules(c.id) r
    where c.is_active and (coalesce(category_filter,'')='' or c.slug=left(category_filter,180))
  ), attributes as (
    select a.id,a.code,a.name,a.data_type,u.symbol as unit,
      case when a.data_type in ('select','multi_select') then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o)) from (
        select o.id,o.label from public.attribute_options o where o.attribute_id=a.id and o.is_active
        order by o.sort_order,o.label,o.id limit 100) o),'[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end as options
    from public.attribute_definitions a join rules r on r.attribute_id=a.id
    left join public.units u on u.id=a.default_unit_id
    where a.is_active and a.is_filterable order by a.sort_order,a.name,a.id limit 32
  ) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)),'[]'::jsonb) from attributes a
$function$

SELECT id,
    product_id,
    variant_id,
    title,
    document_type
   FROM public_catalog.documents;

SELECT id,
    name,
    slug,
    product_code,
    short_description,
    description,
    product_type,
    country_of_origin,
    is_featured,
    is_new_arrival,
    seo_title,
    seo_description,
    published_at,
    updated_at,
    category_name,
    category_slug,
    brand_name,
    image_url,
    image_variants,
    image_key
   FROM public_catalog.products;

SELECT id,
    product_id,
    sku,
    variant_name,
    model_number,
    manufacturer_part_number,
    sale_unit,
    minimum_order_qty,
    minimum_order_unit,
    monthly_supply_capacity,
    capacity_unit,
    lead_time_days,
    availability_status,
    is_default,
    prices,
    specifications
   FROM public_catalog.variants;

SELECT id,
    name,
    slug,
    country_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (logo_path ~ '^https://'::text) THEN logo_path
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS logo_path
   FROM brands b
  WHERE is_active;

SELECT id,
    name,
    slug,
    description,
    parent_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (image_path ~ '^https://'::text) THEN image_path
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS image_path,
    sort_order
   FROM categories c
  WHERE is_active;

SELECT d.id,
    d.product_id,
    d.variant_id,
    d.title,
    d.document_type,
    d.file_extension,
    d.bytes,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.product_code,
    p.slug AS product_slug,
    d.created_at
   FROM ((product_documents d
     JOIN public_catalog.visibility visible ON ((visible.id = d.product_id)))
     JOIN products p ON ((p.id = d.product_id)))
  WHERE (d.is_public AND (d.retired_at IS NULL) AND ((d.variant_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM product_variants v
          WHERE ((v.id = d.variant_id) AND v.is_active)))));

SELECT pr.id,
    pr.variant_id,
    v.product_id,
    pr.currency_code,
    pr.price_type,
    pr.min_price,
    pr.max_price,
    pr.price_unit_id,
    u.symbol AS unit,
    pr.trade_term,
    pr.valid_from,
    pr.valid_until
   FROM (((variant_prices pr
     JOIN product_variants v ON (((v.id = pr.variant_id) AND v.is_active)))
     JOIN public_catalog.visibility p ON ((p.id = v.product_id)))
     JOIN units u ON ((u.id = pr.price_unit_id)))
  WHERE (pr.is_active AND (pr.valid_from <= now()) AND ((pr.valid_until IS NULL) OR (pr.valid_until > now())));

SELECT p.id,
    p.slug,
    p.name,
    p.product_code,
    "left"(p.short_description, 240) AS short_description,
    p.product_type,
    p.country_of_origin,
    p.is_featured,
    p.is_new_arrival,
    c.name AS category_name,
    c.slug AS category_slug,
    b.name AS brand_name,
    b.slug AS brand_slug,
    COALESCE((image.card ->> 'url'::text), image.delivery_url) AS image_url,
    COALESCE((image.card ->> 'key'::text), NULL::text) AS image_key,
    p.published_at,
    p.updated_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (pricing.comparable AND (pricing.priced_variants = ( SELECT count(*) AS count
               FROM product_variants v
              WHERE ((v.product_id = p.id) AND v.is_active)))) THEN jsonb_build_object('type',
            CASE
                WHEN (pricing.low = pricing.high) THEN 'fixed'::text
                ELSE 'range'::text
            END, 'min', (pricing.low)::text, 'max', (pricing.high)::text, 'currency', pricing.currency, 'unit', pricing.unit, 'trade_term', pricing.trade_term, 'valid_until', pricing.expires)
            ELSE jsonb_build_object('type', 'on_request')
        END AS display_price
   FROM (((((products p
     JOIN public_catalog.visibility visible ON ((visible.id = p.id)))
     JOIN categories c ON ((c.id = p.primary_category_id)))
     LEFT JOIN brands b ON (((b.id = p.brand_id) AND b.is_active)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.delivery_url,
            ( SELECT e.value AS e
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.object_manifest) e(value)
                  WHERE ((e.value ->> 'kind'::text) = 'card'::text)
                 LIMIT 1) AS card
           FROM product_media m
          WHERE ((m.product_id = p.id) AND (m.upload_status = 'ready'::text) AND (m.retired_at IS NULL) AND ((m.media_type)::text = 'image'::text) AND ((m.variant_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM product_variants v
                  WHERE ((v.id = m.variant_id) AND v.is_active)))))
          ORDER BY m.is_primary DESC, m.sort_order, m.id
         LIMIT 1) image ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT pr.variant_id) AS priced_variants,
            ((count(DISTINCT ROW(pr.currency_code, pr.price_unit_id, pr.trade_term)) = 1) AND bool_and((((pr.price_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['fixed'::character varying, 'range'::character varying])::text[])) AND (pr.min_price IS NOT NULL) AND (((pr.price_type)::text = 'fixed'::text) OR (pr.max_price IS NOT NULL))))) AS comparable,
            min(pr.min_price) AS low,
            max(COALESCE(pr.max_price, pr.min_price)) AS high,
            min(pr.currency_code) AS currency,
            min((pr.unit)::text) AS unit,
            min((pr.trade_term)::text) AS trade_term,
            min(pr.valid_until) AS expires
           FROM public_catalog.effective_prices pr
          WHERE (pr.product_id = p.id)) pricing ON (true));

SELECT slug,
    (to_jsonb(p.*) || jsonb_build_object('key_features', ( SELECT products.key_features
           FROM products
          WHERE (products.id = p.id)), 'specifications', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(((to_jsonb(s.*) - 'product_id'::text) - 'sort_order'::text) ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.code) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM public_catalog.product_specifications s
          WHERE (s.product_id = p.id)), '[]'::jsonb))) AS product,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(v.*) || jsonb_build_object('packaging', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type', pkg.packaging_type, 'quantity', (pkg.pack_quantity)::text, 'unit', u.symbol, 'description', pkg.package_description) ORDER BY pkg.is_default DESC, pkg.id) AS jsonb_agg
                   FROM (variant_packaging pkg
                     JOIN units u ON ((u.id = pkg.pack_unit_id)))
                  WHERE (pkg.variant_id = v.id)), '[]'::jsonb), 'composition', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fiber', f.name, 'percentage', (fc.percentage)::text) ORDER BY f.name) AS jsonb_agg
                   FROM (variant_fiber_composition fc
                     JOIN fibers f ON (((f.id = fc.fiber_id) AND f.is_active)))
                  WHERE (fc.variant_id = v.id)), '[]'::jsonb), 'equipment', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('brand', b.name, 'model', e.model_name, 'notes', ec.compatibility_notes) ORDER BY b.name, e.model_name) AS jsonb_agg
                   FROM ((variant_equipment_compatibility ec
                     JOIN equipment_models e ON ((e.id = ec.equipment_model_id)))
                     JOIN brands b ON (((b.id = e.brand_id) AND b.is_active)))
                  WHERE (ec.variant_id = v.id)), '[]'::jsonb))) ORDER BY v.is_default DESC, v.sku, v.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT variants.id,
                    variants.product_id,
                    variants.sku,
                    variants.variant_name,
                    variants.model_number,
                    variants.manufacturer_part_number,
                    variants.sale_unit,
                    variants.minimum_order_qty,
                    variants.minimum_order_unit,
                    variants.monthly_supply_capacity,
                    variants.capacity_unit,
                    variants.lead_time_days,
                    variants.availability_status,
                    variants.is_default,
                    variants.prices,
                    variants.specifications
                   FROM public_catalog.variants
                  WHERE (variants.product_id = p.id)
                  ORDER BY variants.is_default DESC, variants.sku, variants.id
                 LIMIT 100) v), '[]'::jsonb) AS variants,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d.*) ORDER BY d.title, d.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT documents.id,
                    documents.product_id,
                    documents.variant_id,
                    documents.title,
                    documents.document_type,
                    documents.file_extension,
                    documents.bytes,
                    documents.product_name,
                    documents.product_code,
                    documents.product_slug,
                    documents.created_at
                   FROM public_catalog.documents
                  WHERE (documents.product_id = p.id)
                  ORDER BY documents.title, documents.id
                 LIMIT 100) d), '[]'::jsonb) AS documents,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'detail', 'url', COALESCE((image.detail ->> 'url'::text), image.delivery_url), 'key', COALESCE((image.detail ->> 'key'::text), ''::text), 'width', COALESCE(((image.detail ->> 'width'::text))::integer, 800), 'height', COALESCE(((image.detail ->> 'height'::text))::integer, 800)) ORDER BY image.is_primary DESC, image.sort_order, image.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT m.id,
                    m.is_primary,
                    m.sort_order,
                    m.delivery_url,
                    ( SELECT e.value AS e
                           FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.object_manifest) e(value)
                          WHERE ((e.value ->> 'kind'::text) = 'detail'::text)
                         LIMIT 1) AS detail
                   FROM product_media m
                  WHERE ((m.product_id = p.id) AND (m.upload_status = 'ready'::text) AND (m.retired_at IS NULL) AND ((m.media_type)::text = 'image'::text) AND ((m.variant_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM product_variants v
                          WHERE ((v.id = m.variant_id) AND v.is_active)))))
                  ORDER BY m.is_primary DESC, m.sort_order, m.id
                 LIMIT 100) image
          WHERE (COALESCE((image.detail ->> 'url'::text), image.delivery_url) IS NOT NULL)), '[]'::jsonb) AS gallery
   FROM public_catalog.products p;

SELECT p.id,
    p.name,
    p.product_code,
    p.short_description,
    p.published_at,
    p.updated_at,
    p.is_featured,
    p.is_new_arrival,
    c.slug AS category_slug,
    b.slug AS brand_slug
   FROM ((products p
     JOIN categories c ON (((c.id = p.primary_category_id) AND c.is_active)))
     LEFT JOIN brands b ON (((b.id = p.brand_id) AND b.is_active)))
  WHERE (((p.status)::text = 'published'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL));

SELECT av.product_id,
    a.code,
    a.name AS label,
    av.value_text AS text,
    (av.value_number)::text AS number,
    av.value_boolean AS "boolean",
    o.label AS option,
    u.symbol AS unit,
    a.sort_order
   FROM ((((product_attribute_values av
     JOIN public_catalog.visibility p ON ((p.id = av.product_id)))
     JOIN attribute_definitions a ON (((a.id = av.attribute_id) AND a.is_active)))
     LEFT JOIN attribute_options o ON (((o.id = av.option_id) AND o.is_active)))
     LEFT JOIN units u ON ((u.id = av.unit_id)))
  WHERE ((av.option_id IS NULL) OR (o.id IS NOT NULL));

SELECT p.id,
    p.name,
    p.slug,
    p.product_code,
    p.short_description,
    p.description,
    p.product_type,
    p.country_of_origin,
    p.is_featured,
    p.is_new_arrival,
    p.seo_title,
    p.seo_description,
    p.published_at,
    p.updated_at,
    c.name AS category_name,
    c.slug AS category_slug,
    b.name AS brand_name,
    media.delivery_url AS image_url,
    COALESCE(media.images, '[]'::jsonb) AS image_variants,
    media.image_key
   FROM (((products p
     JOIN categories c ON (((c.id = p.primary_category_id) AND c.is_active)))
     LEFT JOIN brands b ON (((b.id = p.brand_id) AND b.is_active)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.delivery_url,
            ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', (e.value ->> 'kind'::text), 'url', (e.value ->> 'url'::text), 'width', ((e.value ->> 'width'::text))::integer, 'height', ((e.value ->> 'height'::text))::integer, 'key', (e.value ->> 'key'::text))) AS jsonb_agg
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.object_manifest) e(value)
                  WHERE ((e.value ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['thumbnail'::text, 'card'::text, 'detail'::text]))) AS images,
            ( SELECT (e.value ->> 'key'::text)
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.object_manifest) e(value)
                  WHERE ((e.value ->> 'kind'::text) = 'detail'::text)
                 LIMIT 1) AS image_key
           FROM product_media m
          WHERE ((m.product_id = p.id) AND (m.upload_status = 'ready'::text) AND (m.retired_at IS NULL) AND ((m.media_type)::text = 'image'::text) AND ((m.variant_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM product_variants v
                  WHERE ((v.id = m.variant_id) AND v.is_active)))))
          ORDER BY m.is_primary DESC, m.sort_order, m.id
         LIMIT 1) media ON (true))
  WHERE (((p.status)::text = 'published'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL));

SELECT v.id,
    v.product_id,
    v.sku,
    v.variant_name,
    v.model_number,
    v.manufacturer_part_number,
    u.symbol AS sale_unit,
    (v.minimum_order_qty)::text AS minimum_order_qty,
    mu.symbol AS minimum_order_unit,
    (v.monthly_supply_capacity)::text AS monthly_supply_capacity,
    cu.symbol AS capacity_unit,
    v.lead_time_days,
    v.availability_status,
    v.is_default,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', pr.id, 'currency', pr.currency_code, 'type', pr.price_type, 'min', (pr.min_price)::text, 'max', (pr.max_price)::text, 'unit', pu.symbol, 'trade_term', pr.trade_term, 'valid_until', pr.valid_until, 'tiers', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('min_quantity', (t.min_quantity)::text, 'max_quantity', (t.max_quantity)::text, 'unit_price', (t.unit_price)::text, 'unit', tu.symbol) ORDER BY t.min_quantity) AS jsonb_agg
                   FROM (price_tiers t
                     JOIN units tu ON ((tu.id = t.quantity_unit_id)))
                  WHERE (t.variant_price_id = pr.id)), '[]'::jsonb))) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (variant_prices pr
             JOIN units pu ON ((pu.id = pr.price_unit_id)))
          WHERE ((pr.variant_id = v.id) AND pr.is_active AND (pr.valid_from <= now()) AND ((pr.valid_until IS NULL) OR (pr.valid_until > now())))), '[]'::jsonb) AS prices,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code', a.code, 'label', a.name, 'text', av.value_text, 'number', (av.value_number)::text, 'boolean', av.value_boolean, 'option', o.label, 'unit', au.symbol)) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (((variant_attribute_values av
             JOIN attribute_definitions a ON ((a.id = av.attribute_id)))
             LEFT JOIN attribute_options o ON ((o.id = av.option_id)))
             LEFT JOIN units au ON ((au.id = av.unit_id)))
          WHERE ((av.variant_id = v.id) AND a.is_active)), '[]'::jsonb) AS specifications
   FROM (((((product_variants v
     JOIN products p ON ((p.id = v.product_id)))
     JOIN categories c ON ((c.id = p.primary_category_id)))
     JOIN units u ON ((u.id = v.base_unit_id)))
     JOIN units mu ON ((mu.id = v.minimum_order_unit_id)))
     JOIN units cu ON ((cu.id = v.capacity_unit_id)))
  WHERE (((p.status)::text = 'published'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AND c.is_active AND v.is_active);

SELECT p.id,
    p.slug,
    p.revision
   FROM (products p
     JOIN categories c ON ((c.id = p.primary_category_id)))
  WHERE (((p.status)::text = 'published'::text) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AND c.is_active);
